newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius rupee firms on dollar and pound.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius rupee firms on dollar and pound.

text.p: The Mauritius rupee was fixed firmer against the dollar and pound on Friday, following international trends, dealers said.
The rupee was quoted at a mean commercial rate of 20.1115 against the dollar from Thursday's 20.1265. The rupee traded at a mean of 32.4185 against the pound from 32.5380 on Thursday.
Forex dealers said the rupee's fixing reflected the easing dollar in overnight international trends.
The central bank has intervened twice in the interbank forex market this week. It sold dollars at the prevailing market rates on Tuesday and Wednesday.

"I think the rupee is stabilising. The central bank intervention rates are no longer well below the interbank rates like during the past few months when the rupee appreciated," a dealer said. "Unless something big happens abroad, we see the rupee trading in that range in the immediate future."
A strong rupee would not be in the interest of the island's export sectors, especially the textiles manufacturing firms, the dealer said.
